text:
anya: quick sanity check — ran argus17b quant grid across H100/A100/V100 in us-east/eu-west/apac-sg.

anya: TL;DR: INT8 gives ~2.6-3.0x token/s on H100; FP8 is ~1.9-2.2x. INT8 quality delta (nlg-acc) +0.6–1.8 points vs FP16 depending on prompt set and eval slice.

liam: @bench-bot can you publish the CSV and a compact summary?

bench-bot: Completed bench run, uploaded CSV to gs://redwood-bench/argus17b/2412345678-grid.csv
bench-bot: Compact summary (p50/p99 in ms, tok/s, quality delta vs FP16):

```
GPU    region    cfg    p50(ms)  p99(ms)  tok/s  quality_delta(nlg-acc)
H100   us-east   FP16   42       210      2200   0.0
H100   us-east   FP8    24       150      4500   -0.6
H100   us-east   INT8   18       140      6200   -1.1
A100   eu-west   FP16   58       320      1500   0.0
A100   eu-west   FP8    36       210      2600   -0.7
A100   eu-west   INT8   30       200      3200   -1.5
V100   apac-sg   FP16   102      480      700    0.0
V100   apac-sg   FP8    70       360      1100   -0.9
V100   apac-sg   INT8   60       340      1400   -2.0
```

bench-bot: Notes: INT8 run used per-layer clip-scale sweep + kernel=quant-runner-v3; FP8 used cutlass-fp8-v1. INT8 needs warmup x2 on H100 and A100 to hit stable perf.

rachel: p99 is the gating metric for our conversational SLAs — H100 INT8 p99=140ms looks acceptable-ish for short-turn chat, but APAC V100 INT8 p99=340ms is too high for interactive flows.

todd: back-of-envelope capacity sizing for 1k RPS (50 tokens avg / req):
- H100 INT8 -> ~5 GPUs
- H100 FP8  -> ~8 GPUs
- A100 INT8 -> ~12 GPUs
- A100 FP8  -> ~18 GPUs
- V100 variants -> ~40 GPUs
(assumes sustained tok/s numbers and 80% util headroom)

anya: kernel question — cutlass-fp8-v1 vs quant-runner-v3. liam, any memory or tail-latency tradeoffs?

liam: quant-runner-v3 uses fused attention + packed KV, roughly -12% memory on H100 vs cutlass-fp8-v1. On short sequences (<64) cutlass-fp8-v1 slightly faster on A100 (~7%); quant-runner wins for long sequences and reduces p99 tails due to better batching.

rachel: operational plan: canary FP8 in eu-west first at 20% traffic, monitor nlg-acc and token error spikes. Promote if delta <= 0.8 points. INT8 requires stricter thresholds and manual QA on our hallucination eval set.

todd: rollout config (example):

```
{
  "model": "argus17b",
  "variant": "fp8-cutlass",
  "canary": 0.2,
  "regions": ["eu-west"],
  "fallback": "fp16",
  "monitoring": ["nlg-acc", "token-errors", "latency-p99"]
}
```

eva: add to runbook — regen eval set with longer prompts (>=150 tokens) + aggressive temperature slices; FP8 showed regressions on generation length >200 in a small subset.

anya: thanks. next actions: liam to upload perf traces + kernel logs; rachel to create canary job; todd to refine capacity spreadsheet. I'll open a ticket for INT8 follow-up.
